pullRequests.head: feature/trace-v0-intake-20261112
pullRequests.body:
## Purpose
Start the December curriculum acceleration work without modifying any student-facing lesson, cache, scheduled Grade 10 worker, or existing bulk authoring engine.

## Included
- Read-only Python ZIP intake (`site/tools/bulk/trace_intake.py`) using stdlib only; canonicalizes Grade 10 question-part identities, fingerprints archives, flags incomplete structured steps, and compares with explicitly supplied draft/legacy snapshots.
- Four independent unit tests (`site/tools/bulk/test_trace_intake.py`). Local run: **4 passed**.
- Reproducible source-evidence snapshots, a 16-record Grade 10 reconciliation result and a clearly qualified 60-question A/B pilot protocol under `docs/trace/`.

## Real observations
- 5 WIP ZIPs; 16 unique staging records (14 newly reported + 2 carried-forward stubs).
- 6 records overlap the known unmerged PR #114 draft; these should be reconciled, not counted as fresh published work.
- 3 possible older-edition live-label matches. **Not 2025 textbook equivalence**.
- 8 records have no structured step arrays, while some have working in separate Markdown; do not classify these as missing solutions.
- 14 records report Tamil editorial review pending.

## Nonclaims / blockers
- No complete all-grade textbook denominator yet; no 60-item controlled pilot has been run; no asserted speedup.
- No English/Tamil source-page images rereviewed in this change, no new maths independently certified, no chapter marked complete, no automatic deployment.
- `site/data/class-10.js` is not the full dynamically registered student inventory; reference matches are tentative.
- Existing `site/tools/curriculum_bulk.cjs` remains the publisher and validation engine; chapter release gates/leases remain mandatory.

## Review requirements
Run `python3 -m unittest -v site/tools/bulk/test_trace_intake.py` from a directory that resolves sibling imports (for example `cd site/tools/bulk && python3 -m unittest -v test_trace_intake.py`). Confirm `npm test` and repository CI before marking ready, and reconcile source evidence with 2025 textbooks. Draft is deliberately **not to be merged or deployed** until checks pass.

No changes to five existing daily Grade 10 tasks.
